race.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
race.verdict: EAGLE STORM is drawn higher than ideal but looks open to further progress and can defy a 4 lb rise gained for making a winning nursery debut here. Court Legend has made a positive start in nurseries and remains with potential at this trip, whilst Benedetti should benefit for the step up to 1m on her first start in this company. EAGLE STORM COURT LEGEND BENEDETTI
